ayahs.ar: حمٓ
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem
ayahs.e2: Ḥâ-Mĩm
ayahs.tr: Haa Meeem

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.en: By the clear Book
ayahs.e2: By the clear Book
ayahs.tr: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺
ayahs.tr: Innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.en: On that night is made distinct every precise matter
ayahs.e2: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained
ayahs.tr: Feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem

ayahs.ar: أَمۡرࣰا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
ayahs.en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.e2: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺
ayahs.tr: Amram min 'indinaaa; innaa kunnaa mursileen

ayahs.ar: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
ayahs.e2: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—
ayahs.tr: Rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain
ayahs.e2: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith
ayahs.tr: Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen

ayahs.ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
ayahs.e2: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers
ayahs.tr: Laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves
ayahs.e2: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves
ayahs.tr: Bal hum fee shakkiny yal'aboon

ayahs.ar: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ
ayahs.en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
ayahs.e2: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible
ayahs.tr: Fartaqib Yawma taatis samaaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ
ayahs.en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment
ayahs.e2: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment
ayahs.tr: Yaghshan naasa haazaa 'azaabun aleem

ayahs.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers
ayahs.e2: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”
ayahs.tr: Rabbanak shif 'annal 'azaaba innaa mu'minoon

ayahs.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ
ayahs.en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger
ayahs.e2: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear
ayahs.tr: Annaa lahumuz zikraa wa qad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum mubeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman
ayahs.e2: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”
ayahs.tr: Summaa tawallaw 'anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamum majnoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺
ayahs.tr: Innaa kaashiful 'azaabi qaleelaa; innakum 'aaa'indoon

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution
ayahs.e2: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment
ayahs.tr: Yawma nabtishul batsha tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon

ayahs.ar: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger
ayahs.e2: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma Fir'awna wa jaaa'ahum Rasoolun kareem

ayahs.ar: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ
ayahs.en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.e2: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
ayahs.tr: An addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

ayahs.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ
ayahs.en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority
ayahs.e2: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof
ayahs.tr: Wa al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
ayahs.en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me
ayahs.e2: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺
ayahs.tr: Wa innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon

ayahs.ar: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”
ayahs.tr: Wa il lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people
ayahs.e2: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”
ayahs.tr: Fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.en: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued
ayahs.tr: Fa asri bi'ibaadee lailan innakum muttaba'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned
ayahs.e2: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”
ayahs.tr: Watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon

ayahs.ar: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ
ayahs.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind
ayahs.tr: Kam tarakoo min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: وَزُرُوعࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ
ayahs.en: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.e2: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences
ayahs.tr: Wa zuroo'inw wa maqaa min kareem

ayahs.ar: وَنَعۡمَةࣲ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.en: And comfort wherein they were amused
ayahs.e2: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed
ayahs.tr: Wa na'matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people
ayahs.e2: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people
ayahs.tr: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa qawman aakhareen

ayahs.ar: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved
ayahs.e2: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed
ayahs.tr: Famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
ayahs.en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
ayahs.e2: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad najjainaa Baneee Israaa'eela minal'azaabil muheen

ayahs.ar: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors
ayahs.e2: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor
ayahs.tr: Min Fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds
ayahs.e2: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others
ayahs.tr: Wa laqadikh tarnaahum 'alaa 'ilmin 'alal 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial
ayahs.e2: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test
ayahs.tr: Wa aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying
ayahs.e2: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say
ayahs.tr: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i la yaqooloon

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.en: There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected
ayahs.e2: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected
ayahs.tr: In hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa wa maa nahnu bimun shareen

ayahs.ar: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful
ayahs.e2: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”
ayahs.tr: Faatoo bi aabaaa'inaaa inkuntum saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals
ayahs.e2: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked
ayahs.tr: Ahum khayrun am qawmu Tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play
ayahs.e2: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
ayahs.tr: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa baina humaa laa'ibeen

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know
ayahs.e2: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know
ayahs.tr: Maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all
ayahs.e2: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—
ayahs.tr: Inna yawmal fasli meeqaatuhum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped
ayahs.e2: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped
ayahs.tr: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.en: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.e2: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful
ayahs.tr: Illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.e2: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm
ayahs.tr: Inna shajarataz zaqqoom

ayahs.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
ayahs.en: Is food for the sinful
ayahs.e2: will be the food of the evildoer
ayahs.tr: Ta'aamul aseem

ayahs.ar: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
ayahs.en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.e2: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies
ayahs.tr: Kalmuhli yaghlee filbutoon

ayahs.ar: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.en: Like the boiling of scalding water
ayahs.e2: like the boiling of hot water
ayahs.tr: Kaghalyil hameem

ayahs.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire
ayahs.tr: Khuzoohu fa'tiloohu ilaa sawaaa'il Jaheem

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water
ayahs.e2: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”
ayahs.tr: Summa subboo fawqa raasihee min 'azaabil hameem

ayahs.ar: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
ayahs.en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble
ayahs.e2: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one
ayahs.tr: Zuq innaka antal 'azeezul kareem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute
ayahs.e2: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”
ayahs.tr: Inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينࣲ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen

ayahs.ar: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ
ayahs.en: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.e2: amid Gardens and springs
ayahs.tr: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسࣲ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other
ayahs.e2: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another
ayahs.tr: Yalbasoona min sundusinw wa istbraqim mutaqaabileen

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ
ayahs.en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.e2: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes
ayahs.tr: Kazaalika wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een

ayahs.ar: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure
ayahs.e2: There they will call for every fruit in serenity
ayahs.tr: Yad'oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen

ayahs.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.e2: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—
ayahs.tr: Laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa wa qaqaahum 'azaabal jaheem

ayahs.ar: فَضۡلࣰا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
ayahs.en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment
ayahs.e2: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph
ayahs.tr: Fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful
ayahs.tr: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la'allahum yatazakkaroon

ayahs.ar: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.en: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end]
ayahs.e2: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting
ayahs.tr: Fartaqib innahum murta qiboon
